items.title: Microsoft AI launches seven new MAI models around Ignite 2026
items.summary_en: Microsoft AI published a post about launching seven new MAI models, described in search snippets as covering coding (MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash), security (MAI Cyber 2 Flash, with 12B active parameters), image editing (MAI Image 2.7) and voice (MAI Realtime 1). Microsoft also introduced MAI Licensed Weights, which lets customers customize a frontier MAI model with their own data and run it in their own Azure environment. Performance and cost comparisons (e.g. versus GPT 6 Astra on CyberGym-E2E) are Microsoft's own claims.
items.notes: Page could not be fetched (microsoft.ai not in allowed network domains). Content taken from WebSearch snippets of the official URL; the date is inferred from the Ignite 2026 timing and archive labels, not read from the page. Benchmark and cost figures are unverified vendor claims. Needs manual check.

items.title: Microsoft Ignite 2026: MAI keynote transcript published
items.summary_en: Microsoft AI published a transcript of its Ignite 2026 MAI keynote, in which Mustafa Suleyman is reported to frame the strategy as frontier-level capability at a price organizations can afford at scale. The keynote is the source of the model and Licensed Weights claims above.
items.notes: Not fetched; URL and gist from search result only. Date inferred from Ignite timing (Nov 17-20, 2026). Overlaps with the seven-models item; the synthesis agent may want to merge them.

items.title: Satya Nadella Ignite 2026 keynote transcript (PDF)
items.summary_en: Microsoft News hosts a PDF transcript of Satya Nadella's Ignite keynote from November 2026. Secondary search summaries of Ignite say Microsoft presented Copilot Workspaces (shared space for people and agents), Microsoft IQ, Project Perception security agents (reported generally available), Agent 365 Business Analytics, and an AI Transparency Initiative with 40+ organizations. The keynote text itself was not read.
items.notes: Transcript not opened. The list of announcements comes from WebSearch summaries drawing on secondary coverage (e.g. SiliconANGLE, TechDogs), which is not cited as an item here. The exact publication date is not confirmed. Verify against the transcript and the Ignite 2026 Book of News.

coverage_note: Microsoft published substantial official material in the window: Ignite 2026 (Nov 17-20) with seven new MAI models, MAI Licensed Weights and the Nadella and MAI keynotes. However, blogs.microsoft.com/ai and microsoft.ai were not reachable by WebFetch (hosts not in the session's allowed network domains), so blogs.microsoft.com and microsoft.ai need to be allowed before these can be verified. All items rest on search-result snippets of official URLs, so confidence is primary-inferred and dates are inferred. Not covered: other posts on blogs.microsoft.com/ai from Nov 18-28, Microsoft Research, and official social accounts. No post-Ignite announcements from Nov 21-28 were found.
